ObjectRest.description: A scene object comes to rest: judged on the declared pose channel whose source is

object.description: The scene object whose pose is judged.

criteria.description: Every criterion to judge by, its dwell the object's; None for the signal the channel's runtime declares, with this condition's dwell.

dwell_ns.description: How long the object must stay within the signal's bounds, from its own dynamics; None only with criteria.

dwell_source.description: Where the dwell comes from; None only with criteria.

RestCriteria.description: When a channel's readings count as at rest, as declared by whoever produces them.

cadence_ns.description: The spacing of samples the criteria were declared for.

max_gap_ns.description: The largest spacing between samples still treated as continuous.

dwell_ns.description: How long the readings must stay within bounds; None only for a pose source's signal, whose objects supply their own.

variation.description: The most each element's range may be over the dwell, one bound per element of the channel; joint-position channels only.

translation_m.description: The most each position coordinate's range may be over the dwell; pose only.

rotation_rad.description: The largest angle any orientation may be from the dwell's first; pose only.

source.description: Where the values come from: a datasheet, a driver, or a measurement.
